authorization.request: 用户要求修复无法安装/更新并已明确要求推送发布；本次仅修改 DSH Store，真实 Desktop Profile 操作仍单独确认。

objective: 修正 DSH Desktop 插件安装中的 Store 预检拦截和 Already up to date 误报，同时让 Store 包版本升级到 0.9.24，使 GitHub 自更新有新的包版本可识别。

change.installAuthority: Store 固定来源/包身份和用户完整 Commit 确认继续作为基础门槛；DSH inspect 只提供建议。可用时把确认请求交给 DSH installBundle 作最终判断；inspect 缺失或拒绝不再在 Store 中终止。
change.outcomeReconciliation: installBundle 失败后仅查询一次 DSH listBundles；当 Desktop 明确列出相同包名、版本、仓库，且 source 可见 Commit 与目标一致时报告已安装且无依赖变更，否则保留 DSH 失败/未知状态。绝不重试安装。
change.catalog: 本 Source PR 不改 Catalog pin；Catalog 更新在 source Commit 固定后另建 fresh release plan 和 CI-checked PR。
change.protectedBoundary: 不改 DSH 核心、@deepseek-ai/*、Catalog admission 或真实 DSH Profile。

commands.expected: all disposable Desktop install and reconciliation cases pass
REGISTRY_OK and full repository test suite passes

gates: Every changed or new file is in this exact scope; base Commit and precondition hashes must match.
All repository checks and the exact-head pull request CI must pass before merge.
Full Commit, canonical GitHub source, safe paths, package identity, protected-component checks, and typed per-install confirmation remain mandatory.
DSH inspect warnings are advice only; DSH installBundle and then Desktop listBundles determine the reported install state.
No blind retry, real Profile write, DSH restart, DSH core change, or Catalog status/admission change is included.
After source merge, update the Store Catalog pin in a separate newly hashed plan and independently read back GitHub Raw, Pages, dsh.store, and dsh-store.cn.

rollback.source: Revert the source change only through an auditable CI-checked PR.
rollback.catalog: Catalog remains on 0.9.23 until its separate release is merged; abandon that Catalog PR if source acceptance fails.
rollback.profile: No real DSH Profile or package was changed.

healthCheck: Verify the typed plan, full npm run check, disposable Desktop fixtures, and package dry run; then require exact-head CI before merging. Public Catalog/storefront and real Desktop acceptance remain separate evidence gates.

verification.publicCatalogAndStorefronts: pending separate Catalog release and independent readback
